items.title: 30-yr Treasury yield at a near-two-decade high
items.detail: Long-end yields (10Y ~4.71%, 30Y ~5.25%) are driving a de-rating of high-multiple, long-duration equities - the primary risk to tech, AI-power and SaaS this week.

items.title: NVDA earnings Aug 26 is a market-wide binary
items.detail: With semis already routed (MU -6.2%, TSM -2.3%), NVDA's after-close report on Aug 26 can set the tone for the entire AI complex either way.

items.title: Jackson Hole / Warsh (Aug 28) with no forward guidance
items.detail: Fed Chair Warsh has curtailed forward guidance, so his first Jackson Hole speech carries unusual surprise potential 19 days before the Sept 16 FOMC.

items.title: Sticky inflation vs September-cut pricing
items.detail: Inflation is ~3.4% while markets price a high chance of a September cut - a hot data point or hawkish Warsh could reprice the front end sharply.

items.title: Oil / Strait of Hormuz headline risk
items.detail: Brent ~$94.39 on a failed Iran deal; a reopening could sink energy fast, while further escalation is an inflation/tax-on-growth risk.

items.title: Narrow leadership / thin 52-wk-high breadth
items.detail: Only ~20 S&P names hit 52-wk highs Friday (mostly healthcare/energy) - leadership is narrow, leaving the tape vulnerable if those two sectors stall.

items.title: VIX complacency
items.detail: VIX ~15.90 despite the bond-market volatility - low hedging demand can amplify a downside surprise from NVDA or Warsh.
